published_rule_basis.authors: Thong M. Dao, Frank McGroarty, Andrew Urquhart
published_rule_basis.title: A calendar effect: Weekend overreaction (and subsequent reversal) in spot FX rates
adopted_elements: top and bottom 5 percent weekend-gap tails
five years represented by 260 completed weekly observations

weekend_gap_definition.friday_reference: close of the exact Friday 23:00 H1 bar
weekend_gap_definition.monday_reference: open of the exact Monday 00:00 H1 bar

tail_estimator.window: immediately preceding 260 valid completed weekend gaps for the same symbol
tail_estimator.ordering: ascending foreign-currency log gaps, timestamp ascending for deterministic equality
tail_estimator.upward_signal: current gap strictly greater than upper threshold
tail_estimator.downward_signal: current gap strictly less than lower threshold

entry.direct_pair_mapping: foreign BUY=pair BUY; foreign SELL=pair SELL
entry.inverse_pair_mapping: foreign BUY=pair SELL; foreign SELL=pair BUY
entry.signals: each symbol independent; at most one position per symbol

exit.scheduled_target: Friday 23:55:00 broker-server time of the signal week
exit.window: first executable tick in [23:55:00,next market close)
exit.protective_stop: 3.0 * Wilder D1 ATR14 measured from the last completed D1 bar at entry

execution_and_risk.volume_rounding: down to broker step; never round above risk budget
execution_and_risk.orders_and_positions: tester-only until every Development gate passes

cost_and_execution_cells.swap: frozen FP Markets point-mode long/short specification captured in V26

prohibited: alternate entry or exit time after results
sealed OOS access before every Development gate passes
demo before every Development gate passes
